name: Quahuacan Cliff
description: Quahuacan Cliff is an area located in Natlan. The Flower-Feather Clan is located here. After learning about how the Fatui were destabilizing the situation in Nod-Krai, Pyro Archon Mavuika arranged with the Flower-Feather Clan's elders to establish a new, simple harbor. The Flower-Feather Clan would receive and register the inevitable growing number of people fleeing Nod-Krai, along with the consultation of Zhuoxin on how to suit the needs of the new arrivals.[1]
